# Daily Dashboard V0.5.14

The calendar now follows the new day at midnight in its configured time zone. Day, week and workweek views update their date, today highlight and event query without restarting Dashboard. Google, Microsoft and iCalendar sources refresh for the new day.

- Handles week/year boundaries and daylight-saving changes.
- Preserves dates you have deliberately browsed to. Select **Today** to resume automatic tracking.
- Refreshes after sleep, returning to the app or reconnecting. Failed refreshes retry after one minute; obsolete responses cannot replace the new date range.
- Calendar and weather share the local-midnight clock. V0.5.13 weather rollover remains supported.
- Supports Windows and macOS, preserving settings and monitor bindings.

Install over the existing version, or use Settings → Updates.
